fullPassage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.

questions.passage: Agritourism is an ①<u>increasingly</u> popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun ②<u>educational</u> opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives ③<u>valuable</u> insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of ④<u>sustain</u> agriculture.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 지속 가능한(sustainable) 농업.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sustain → sustainable: 명사 agriculture를 수식하려면 형용사 필요. sustain(동사: 유지하다)이 아닌 sustainable(형용사: 지속 가능한)
❌ ① increasingly: 부사. popular 수식 정상
❌ ② educational: 형용사. opportunity 수식 정상
❌ ③ valuable: 형용사. insights 수식 정상
det.tip: sustain(동사) → sustainable(형용사: 지속 가능한). 명사 앞에는 형용사

questions.passage: Most tourists spend time ①<u>visiting</u> farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to ②<u>providing</u> fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can ③<u>take</u> place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income ④<u>regarding</u> of the seasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 계절에 관계없이(regardless).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ regarding → regardless: 'regardless of'(~에 관계없이)가 원문. regarding(~에 관하여)은 다른 의미
❌ ① visiting: 'spend time visiting' 동명사 정상
❌ ② providing: 'In addition to providing' 전치사 뒤 동명사 정상
❌ ③ take: 'can take place' 조동사 뒤 원형 정상
det.tip: regardless of(~에 관계없이) ≠ regarding(~에 관하여). 혼동 주의

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, ①<u>connect</u> with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity ②<u>what</u> they cannot have in cities. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or ③<u>feeding</u> animals. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also ④<u>benefit</u> the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 도시에서 가질 수 없는 기회 — 관계대명사 that/which.
det.analysis:
✅ ② what → that/which: 선행사 'opportunity'가 있으므로 목적격 관계대명사 that 또는 which 사용. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사로 여기서 부적합
❌ ① connect: 원형. 'allows tourists to experience, connect, and learn' 병렬 정상
❌ ③ feeding: 동명사. 'visiting, picking, or feeding' 병렬 정상
❌ ④ benefit: 동사 원형. 'operations also benefit' 정상
det.tip: 선행사 있음 → that/which. 선행사 없음 → what. opportunity(선행사) + that/which

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the ①<u>agricultural</u> industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, ②<u>picking</u> fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or ③<u>avoid</u> farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of ④<u>survival</u> for many small farms today.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농장 일을 돕는다(help with).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ avoid → help with: 원문은 'help with farm chores'(농장 일을 돕다). avoid(피하다)는 체험 관광 맥락과 반대
❌ ① agricultural: 원문 일치
❌ ② picking: 원문 일치
❌ ④ survival: 원문 일치
det.tip: help with(~을 돕다) ↔ avoid(~을 피하다). 체험 관광에서는 능동적 참여

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a ①<u>stable</u> income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also ②<u>benefit</u> the surrounding communities by ③<u>attracting</u> tourists to the area. The economic ④<u>decline</u> from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 교통량 증가로 인한 경제적 활성화(boost).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ decline → boost: 원문은 'economic boost'(경제적 활성화). decline(감소)은 '좋다(good)'는 결론과 모순
❌ ① stable: 원문 일치
❌ ② benefit: 원문 일치
❌ ③ attracting: 원문 일치
det.tip: boost(활성화, 증가) ↔ decline(감소, 쇠퇴). 'can be good'과 호응하는 것은 boost

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun __________ they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 도시에서 가질 수 없는 재미있는 교육적 기회(educational opportunity).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ educational opportunity: 원문 일치. 농촌 체험을 통한 교육적 기회
❌ ① financial reward(재정적 보상): 관광객의 경험과 무관
❌ ② physical challenge(신체적 도전): 교육적 측면 부재
❌ ③ business venture(사업 모험): 관광객 입장이 아님
det.tip: educational opportunity = 교육적 기회. cannot have in cities = 도시에서 가질 수 없는

questions.passage: Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: reduce the number of tourists visiting
ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons

det.korean: 계절에 관계없이 안정적인 수입을 보장한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons: 원문 일치. 비수확기에도 수입 확보
❌ ① reduce tourists: 관광객을 줄이는 것은 반대
❌ ③ increase crop production: 농작물 생산이 아닌 관광 수입
❌ ④ compete with large farms: 대규모 농장과의 경쟁 언급 없음
det.tip: ensure a stable income = 안정적 수입 보장. regardless of = ~에 관계없이

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 농촌 체험 관광은 점점 인기가 높아지고 있다.
농촌 체험 관광은 도시에서도 동일한 경험을 할 수 있다.
관광객들은 농업 산업에 대해 배울 수 없다.
농촌 체험 관광은 자연과의 연결과는 무관하다.

det.korean: 농촌 체험 관광은 점점 인기가 높아지고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 'an increasingly popular form of travel'과 일치
❌ ② 'they cannot have in cities' — 도시에서는 불가
❌ ③ 'learn about the agricultural industry' — 배울 수 있음
❌ ④ 'connect with nature' — 자연 연결 포함
det.tip: increasingly popular = 점점 더 인기 있는

questions.passage: Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 대부분의 관광객은 농장 직판대를 방문하며 시간을 보낸다.
일부 관광객은 옥수수 밭 미로를 탐험할 수 있다.
농촌 체험 관광은 소규모 농장에 필수적인 생존 수단이 되었다.
농촌 체험 관광은 대규모 농장에서만 운영되고 있다.

det.korean: 소규모 농장의 필수적인 생존 수단. '대규모 농장에서만'은 거짓.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 불일치: 원문 'many small farms'. 대규모 아닌 소규모 농장
❌ ① 일치: 'visiting farm stands'
❌ ② 일치: 'navigate a corn maze'
❌ ③ 일치: 'a necessary means of survival'
det.tip: small farms(소규모 농장) ≠ large farms(대규모 농장)

questions.passage: This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 농촌 체험 관광 활동은 수확 시기에만 이루어진다.
농촌 체험 관광은 주변 지역사회에는 도움이 되지 않는다.
교통량 증가가 농촌 사회 전체에 경제적 이익을 가져올 수 있다.
농장 운영자들은 특정 계절에만 안정적 수입을 올릴 수 있다.

det.korean: 교통량 증가가 농촌 사회 전체에 경제적 이익을 가져올 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 원문 'The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community'와 일치
❌ ① 'not in season' — 비수확기에도 가능
❌ ② 'benefit the surrounding communities' — 도움이 됨
❌ ④ 'regardless of the seasons' — 계절에 관계없이
det.tip: 오답은 원문의 정반대: ①수확기만, ②도움 안됨, ④특정 계절만

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: The Decline of Small Farms in Rural Areas
Agritourism: Experiencing Rural Life and Agriculture
How to Start a Farming Business

det.korean: 농촌 체험 관광: 농촌 생활과 농업 체험.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 글 전체가 agritourism의 정의(농촌 생활 체험, 자연 연결, 농업 학습)와 활동 설명
❌ ① decline(쇠퇴) 언급 없음
❌ ② 도시 관광과의 비교가 아닌 농촌 체험 관광 소개
❌ ④ 농업 사업 시작이 아닌 관광 체험
det.tip: 제목 = 글 전체를 아우르는 키워드. agritourism + rural life + agriculture

questions.passage: In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 소규모 농장은 결국 대규모 농장으로 전환해야 살아남을 수 있다.
농촌 체험 관광은 관광객에게만 이익이 되는 일방적 관계이다.
정부의 보조금 없이는 소규모 농장이 생존할 수 없다.
농촌 체험 관광은 소규모 농장의 생존과 지역사회 경제에 모두 기여한다.

det.korean: 농촌 체험 관광은 농장 생존과 지역사회 경제 모두에 기여한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 글 후반부 요지: 농장 수입 안정(survival) + 주변 지역사회 경제 활성화(benefit communities)
❌ ① 대규모 전환 언급 없음
❌ ② 일방적이 아닌 농장+지역사회 양방향 이익
❌ ③ 정부 보조금 언급 없음. 자체 관광 사업으로 해결
det.tip: 양방향 이익: 농장(stable income) + 지역사회(economic boost)

questions.passage: In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year <u>when crops are not in season</u>. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 농작물 수확이 불가능한 시기에는 관광도 중단된다.
농작물 수입이 없는 시기에도 다른 방법으로 수입을 올릴 수 있다.

det.korean: 농작물이 제철이 아닌 시기 = 비수확기에도 수입을 올릴 수 있는 시기.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 비수확기에 관광 활동으로 수입 확보. 이것이 'means of survival'(생존 수단)의 핵심
❌ ① 관광이 중단되지 않음. 비수확기에도 가능
❌ ③ 비수확기에도 관광객이 방문
❌ ④ 비수확기에도 가능. '에만'은 반대
det.tip: 함축의미: 비수확기 = 농작물 수입 0 → 관광으로 수입 확보. means of survival의 이유

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. <u>It</u> provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 It이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농촌 체험 관광(agritourism)이 관광객에게 놀라운 경험을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ It = Agritourism. 첫 문장의 주어를 받는 대명사
❌ ① rural life: 농촌 생활이 경험을 제공한다는 맥락 부적합
❌ ② the agricultural industry: 산업이 아닌 관광이 주어
❌ ④ nature: 자연이 교육적 기회를 제공한다는 맥락 부적합
det.tip: It = 앞 문장의 주어(Agritourism). 문단의 핵심 주어를 추적

questions.passage: By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for <u>the entire rural community</u>. Agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. This is why agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 the entire rural community가 가리키는 범위로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농장과 주변 지역사회 전체.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ entire rural community = 농촌 지역 전체. 농장뿐 아니라 주변 지역사회(surrounding communities)까지 포함
❌ ① 농장 운영자뿐 아니라 주변 지역 포함
❌ ② 관광객은 수혜자가 아닌 방문자
❌ ③ 도시가 아닌 농촌(rural) 지역
det.tip: entire = 전체의. rural community = 농촌 지역사회. surrounding communities 포함
